Start the Survey Solutions Listing Application

Source: R/runapp.R
runListingApp.Rd

A wrapper function to start the interactive Shiny application. Please make sure you have read the documentation on how to use the app at https://datanalytics.worldbank.org/SpatialSamplingManual/.

Usage

runListingApp(
  launch.browser = TRUE,
  admuser = NULL,
  admpass = NULL,
  provider = c("google", "vantor", "maxar")
)

Arguments

launch.browser

If true, the system's default web browser will be launched automatically after the app is started. Defaults to true in interactive sessions only. The value of this parameter can also be a function to call with the application's URL.

admuser

Character string specifying the admin username (optional).

admpass

Character string specifying the admin password (optional).

provider

Character string specifying the satellite imagery provider: "google" (default, uses googleway and a Google Maps API key) or "vantor" / "maxar" (uses leaflet and vantorr with Vantor/Maxar API credentials).

Value

No return value, called for side effects (launches the interactive 'Shiny' application).

Details

This application is part of the suite of tools facilitating survey implementation with Survey Solutions. Enumeration Areas (e.g., sampled with the JDC-Survey Solutions Spatial Sampling application) can be used to enumerate all buildings visible within the boundaries on a Google or Vantor (Maxar) satellite map. The enumerated buildings can then be used for the second-stage sampling frame and to draw survey units within each cluster.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  runListingApp()
  runListingApp(provider = "vantor")
}
